integrity: Two self-contained implementations use distinct resolving tests. All claimed numerical invariants are checked by exhaustive finite searches; only the C++ implementation computes the whole dihedral-orbit eccentricity spectrum. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive finite theorem for a fixed labelled 40-vertex graph; it does not imply a family formula or a result about untested graphs. Earlier literature establishes the metric dimension but was not found to cover the exchange-graph metric. Unindexed prior results remain a possible overlap risk.
title: Exchange geometry of metric bases of \(\operatorname{GP}(20,3)\)
